mentions.name: Jazz
mentions.description: A resourceful CLI assistant that uses a hierarchy of dedicated tools, system commands, and "Skills" to manage Git history, local files, calendar, and inbox. Built for speed, safety, and system-level resourcefulness.
mentions.source_excerpt: Jazz (https://github.com/lvndry/jazz): A resourceful CLI assistant that actually does things. It uses a hierarchy of dedicated tools, system commands, and "Skills" to manage everything from your Git history and local files to your calendar and inbox. Built for speed, safety, and system-level resourcefulness.
